notes: ἐν τῷ καθεξῆς: the ASV's two-word 'soon afterwards' answers to the adverb alone, so rule 94's precondition (one English word for preposition plus complement) fails and both ἐν and τῷ stand as their own unrepresented units rather than forming a compound.
The καί of the ἐγένετο idiom is aligned to the complementizer 'that'; LUK.8.22 analyses the same idiom the same way (rule 24).
